class.name: PropertyAnimation
class.brief_description: A property animated to a value by [method SceneTree.animate_property].
class.description: Returned by [method SceneTree.animate_property], it tells when the animation ends, e.g. to [code]await[/code] it: [codeblocks] [gdscript] await get_tree().animate_property(self, "modulate:a", 0.0, 0.3).finished queue_free() [/gdscript] [csharp] await ToSignal(GetTree().AnimateProperty(this, "modulate:a", 0.0f, 0.3f), PropertyAnimation.SignalName.Finished); QueueFree(); [/csharp] [/codeblocks] Animating the property again replaces the animation, which is then interrupted, and the new one continues from where the property is. [b]Note:[/b] Property animations can't be created with [code]new()[/code].

method.name: get_final_value
method.description: Returns the value the property is animated to.

method.name: get_object
method.description: Returns the animated object, or [code]null[/code] once it's freed.

method.name: get_property
method.description: Returns the animated property, as a property path such as [code]^":position:x"[/code].

method.name: is_ignoring_time_scale
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the animation ignores [member Engine.time_scale], see [method set_ignore_time_scale].

method.name: is_interrupted
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the animation ended before reaching its value: another animation of the property replaced it, it was stopped with [method SceneTree.stop_property_animation], or its object was freed.

method.name: set_ignore_time_scale
method.description: If [param ignore] is [code]true[/code], the animation plays at the same speed whatever the [member Engine.time_scale], e.g. for the user interface of a slowed down or paused game. Returns this animation, so it can be chained: [codeblock] get_tree().animate_property(panel, "position", Vector2(0, 0), 0.2).set_ignore_time_scale() [/codeblock]

signal.name: finished
signal.description: Emitted when the animation ends, after reaching its value or interrupted, see [method is_interrupted].
